Source: ServUO scripts: Services/Harvest (Mining, Lumberjacking, Fishing), tool classes, High Seas fish tables, SeriousFun Custom/Gathering. Core expansions on, Siege off. Tile ids are expanded (no ranges); seconds for times; chances in percent unless named BaseChance (a 0..1 probability).

Rules.Target: The player targets a land tile or static; its id picks the first definition (in order) whose Tiles contain it. Static ids are matched after masking with 0x3FFF, so a graphic >= 0x4000 counts as graphic & 0x3FFF.
Rules.Range: The target must be within MaxRange tiles (Chebyshev) when starting and on every effect tick.
Rules.Bank: The world is cut into Width x Height cells per map; each cell holds a random MinTotal..MaxTotal and one vein. With RandomizeVeins the vein is picked at random (by Veins' Chance) when the cell is created and again on each refill; without it, it is fixed per cell. The first harvest from a full cell starts a MinRespawnSeconds..MaxRespawnSeconds timer after which the cell is full again. A harvest needs ConsumedPerHarvest left and takes ConsumedPerHarvest (whatever the yield).
Rules.Timing: Effect: Count (random from Counts) ticks, the first at once and then every DelaySeconds; each tick plays an action from Actions and, SoundDelaySeconds later, a sound from Sounds; the last tick's sound also resolves the harvest. DurationSeconds is therefore (Count-1) x Delay + SoundDelay.
Rules.Vein: Resource = the vein's Fallback when FallbackChance > random, or when the player's skill is below the Primary's ReqSkill or MinSkill and there is a Fallback; otherwise the Primary.
Rules.Skill: Success needs skill >= ReqSkill and a skill check on MinSkill..MaxSkill (ServUO: chance (skill - Min) / (Max - Min), gains possible while skill < cap and the chance is between 0 and 1). On failure the definition's Fail message.
Rules.Yield: One random type of the resource's Types (system-specific selection noted per definition). Stackable yield amount: on Felucca ConsumedPerFeluccaHarvest (granite 3) when the bank has that many, else ConsumedPerHarvest; with HumanBonus a human gets ceil(amount x 1.1) 10% of the time (if the bank has it). Felucca is treated as a special map: everywhere else uses ConsumedPerHarvest.
Rules.Bonus: After each successful harvest one roll on BonusResources (Chance in %, the null-Type entry is 'nothing'); a find needs skill base >= ReqSkill and the Map when one is given.
Rules.Tools: Tool uses: UsesPerHarvest is taken on each successful skill roll and the tool is destroyed at 0 (ToolBroke message). DurabilityLossChance is the shard's rule for pickaxes and hatchets: that % chance per successful roll to lose 1 hit point, then 1 max hit point, and break at 1.
Rules.ShardToolMods: SeriousFun (Custom/Gathering/GatherMods.cs, not exported): pickaxes, shovels and hatchets can carry modifiers: Yield +5..50%, NodeSaving 5..50% chance not to deplete the bank, SkillBonus, CarryWeight, ResourceWeight; artifact ones Weightless, EndlessNode, Motherlode (15% chance of also getting the next resource's first type if skill allows), Swift (half DelaySeconds), Bountiful (second bonus roll when the first gives nothing).

GargoylesPickaxe.Effect: Ore: the bank's vein is treated as the next vein in the list (Iron->Dull Copper ... Verite->Valorite; Valorite stays). On a harvest of the vein's primary resource, 10% chance to spawn that resource's Elemental (25% ore-elemental creature) next to the miner, attacking.

ImprovedRockHammer.Effect: Ore: always gives the resource's granite when Mining base >= 100, otherwise nothing.

RockHammer.Effect: Ore: stone mining (when learned and toggled, Mining base >= 100) succeeds 50% instead of 15%.

ShardOreVeins.Notes: SeriousFun custom: a visible outcrop (graphic 0x9CB0-0x9CB3, or spire 0x9CAC for Agapite and up 40% of the time) that always yields its own metal (its vein = that resource with 100% chance, no fallback), holds Amount ore, needs Mining >= that resource's ReqSkill, ignores the area bank, and regrows elsewhere in its zone after RespawnSeconds. Mined like an Ore tile (gems, stone, tool mods, human bonus all apply).

Notes: Tile list m_MountainAndCaveTiles repeats [296] (harmless).
Every resource's Stone (granite) and Elemental (a creature, see the Gargoyle's pickaxe) come from the third and second types of ServUO's HarvestResource; normal mining gives only the ore.
Bonus resources: CrystallineBlackrock only on Ter Mur (Map). Rolled after every successful harvest; the find needs Mining base >= ReqSkill and is placed at the feet if the pack is full.

High Seas niter: on a boat or in a dungeon (not the Trammel/Felucca surface; Ilshenar counts as dungeon) a harvest may uncover a NiterDeposit of size 1-5 (+1 by luck) instead, chance Mining/9999 + luck/150000 (a third less on a boat); a dungeon bank rolls only once - not exported as a rule.
Void-pool HarvestMaps, Caddellite (Khaldun) and the region's resource swap (Region.GetResource) can change the result - not exported.
Iron beetles mine the land tile in front of them with this definition.
Mining reveals the miner when it starts.

Notes: Rolled before the normal catch (FishInfo.GetSpecialItem), with a fishing pole only (crabs/lobsters are lobster-trap catches and are skipped). Named fish: in list order, the baited fish first; each needs Fishing >= MinSkill, deep water when DeepWater, and the place in Where (a map name, a region name, 'T2A' = the Lost Lands, 'TrammelAndFelucca' = those maps outside the Lost Lands, 'Fire Island', 'Gravewater Lake' (Malas; no roll, always matches)); it is caught when BaseChance x bait strength > random (bait strength 1, or 2 when the pole is baited for it, 3 with enhanced bait, plus fishing attire bonuses; BaseChance x10 when a magical fish finder shows a school). A later match overwrites an earlier one.

Common: if no named fish, chance Fishing/121.5 to catch one random type from the first group that applies: Dungeon (a dungeon region, skill >= 106), DeepWater (skill >= 80), Shore (not deep, not dungeon, skill >= 50).
Lava fishing (lava hook) only rolls the named list.

Mutations: after a successful skill roll, entries are tried in order; an entry needs Fishing base >= ReqSkill and DeepWater entries need deep water (Trammel, Felucca or Tokuno deep sea); it hits when (Fishing - MinSkill) / (MaxSkill - MinSkill) > random, giving one of its Types at random (Nothing = the catch fails). SpecialFish Named catches are never mutated (Common ones can be).

Skill gain: in deep water below 75 Fishing the catch always succeeds with no gain; outside deep water at 75+ it always succeeds with no gain; otherwise the normal ReqSkill + skill check on MinSkill..MaxSkill.

TreasureMap / MessageInABottle / SpecialFishingNet catches arrive inside a sea serpent (25% deep sea serpent) spawned within 10 tiles on deep water, with message 503170. BigFish and SOS chests are placed at the feet when the pack is full.

Lava (LavaTiles, only with a lava hook on the pole; ServUO matches the raw graphic id of land or static against the whole list): no normal fish; LavaMutations are tried in order (skill capped at 120, chance x1.5 on Felucca-rules maps), then the named SpecialFish list. Bank consumption = item amount (halved, rounded up, on Felucca rules). On failure the hook loses a use with chance 0.5 / (Fishing / 50).
Fishing.m_LavaTiles contains 4560, 4561, 4562 between 4859 and 4864 (probably meant 4860-4862); kept as written.
SOS: with an SOS in the pack whose target is within 60 tiles (Trammel/Felucca), resources are always available and every catch is shipwreck loot or the SOS chest (16 or 17 outcomes) - not exported.
Quests (Collector's rainbow pearls, Underworld SomethingFishy/ScrapingtheBottom) and Charybdis (High Seas, Oracle of the Sea + Charybdis bait, 100 Fishing) take over the harvest - not exported.
Hooks: each catch attempt uses one hook charge; bait loses a use when something is caught. Fishing pole uses (UsesRemaining) only count on Siege.
The pole is moved into the hand (unequipping both hands) when fishing from the pack.
